cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

mechanism: A supervises an independent witness account before admitting personal commitment to the impossible shadow.
confusable: Seeking proof alone is D152; D160 requires B's admission before A reveals how much A already believes.
comparison: A disputed sequence of shadow and chair differs from a restaurant companion reluctant to eat animated soup.
seedUse: Keep observation order and held-door reveal, adding a shared practical reason to establish the record.
